IT'S HERE 🩷 Today Taylor didn't just drop a new single — she opened a whole new door. 'Patient Zero' is out as a single, and it turns out to be the lead of something bigger: The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore.

The Encore expands last year's album with four new tracks — 'Patient Zero,' 'Cleveland!,' 'Pink Clouding' and 'Babylon' — landing as tracks 13 through 16. She teased the whole thing for two weeks by swapping every O in her bios for a zero, and the group chats have not recovered since.

We already keep the entire Showgirl era mapped on the site — the announcement, a song-by-song guide, every milestone with a citation — and today it got four brand-new chapters to grow into.

originalBody:
The Joe Jonas summer is one of my favorite chapters to explain to new fans 🤍 It's 2008, Taylor's 18 and deep in the making of Fearless, and for about three months she and Joe are one of the most talked-about young couples going.

Then it ends — famously, in a phone call clocked at 27 seconds. But she doesn't bury it: 'Forever & Always' lands on Fearless as the song everyone reads as her reply, and the heartbreak becomes part of the record instead of a secret.

That's exactly what Blank Spaces is for — not gossip, but a confirmed, sourced map of who she actually wrote about and when. This is the chapter right after her early solo years: the first famous name on the timeline.
